children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may rise into a range of 4,949-4,990 ringgit per metric ton, following its stabilisation around 4,814 ringgit.
The fall from 5,031 ringgit is classified as a consolidation around 4,918 ringgit, the April 1 high. The strong surge on August 28 confirms a completion of the consolidation.

The uptrend is considered intact within a rising channel, which suggests a target zone of 5,166-5,217 ringgit. On the hourly chart, the contract has pierced briefly above a resistance at 4,894 ringgit a few times, the 38.2% retracement of the uptrend from 4,670 ringgit.
Chances are the market may rise towards 4,947 ringgit. Support is at 4,870 ringgit, a break below which could trigger a all towards the 4,851-4,859 ringgit range.
